citations.assessment: Ephraim Maksha’ah is introduced as Rabbi Meir’s disciple, transmitting a teaching about Abraham.
The transmission is in Rabbi Meir’s name. Keep the local combination of references.
The midrash gives Ephraim’s teaching in Rabbi Meir’s name on Tamar.
The other midrash gives Ephraim’s teaching. This establishes the locus of the underlying story, with Yedei Moshe’s exact wording held separately.
